historyMission.title: 📄 History & Mission
historyMission.subtitle: Get to Know Pawplan Pet Clinic
historyMission.p1: Founded with deep love and understanding of the bond between humans and their pets, Dr. Parichat Wongwan and the team created a space that is not just a clinic, but a warm and safe "second home" for your beloved animals.
historyMission.p2: We believe good pet health starts with attentive, professional care. Pawplan is committed to being part of planning and delivering the best healthcare for your pet — with comprehensive diagnostic and treatment services, experienced specialists, and modern medical equipment for effective treatment.
historyMission.p3: Since opening day, Pawplan has remained committed to providing high-standard pet healthcare alongside warm, friendly relationships with owners, so you can always trust that your pet receives the very best.
historyMission.m1desc: Delivering diagnostic and treatment services at the highest professional standards with modern medical technology
historyMission.m2desc: Focused on educating and advising owners to prevent disease and plan long-term pet healthcare appropriate for each life stage
historyMission.m3desc: Making pets and owners feel comfortable, safe, and warmly welcomed by our team
historyMission.m4desc: Treating every pet with love, compassion, and understanding as an important member of your family

dogArticles.title: 🐶 Dog Articles
dogArticles.subtitle: Reliable health and care information from Pawplan veterinarians for the best quality of life for your four-legged companion
dogArticles.art1title: The Silent Threat of Heartworm: Prevention is Better than Cure
dogArticles.art1snippet: Heartworm is a deadly threat that can kill dogs if not properly prevented and treated. Understand the symptoms and prevention to protect your beloved companion.
dogArticles.art2title: Essential Vaccines for Dogs: What New Owners Must Know
dogArticles.art2snippet: A complete guide for new dog owners about essential vaccinations to protect your puppy from serious diseases.
dogArticles.art3title: Checklist! 7 Forbidden Foods Deadly to Dogs
dogArticles.art3snippet: Keep your dog safe from dangerous foods you may not know about. The 7 foods to strictly avoid.
dogArticles.art4title: First 3-Month Puppy Care Guide: Vaccines, Nutrition & Socialization
dogArticles.art4snippet: Start your puppy's life right with a comprehensive care guide covering the first 3 months — vaccines, nutrition, and socialization training.
dogArticles.art5title: Easy Dog Teeth Brushing — Prevent Tartar Without Anesthesia
dogArticles.art5snippet: Oral health care is essential. Learn the correct way to brush your dog's teeth to prevent dental problems and reduce the need for sedation.
dogArticles.art6title: 5 Warning Signs of Kidney Disease in Senior Dogs
dogArticles.art6snippet: Kidney disease is common in older dogs. Learn 5 key warning signs for fast diagnosis and treatment.

catArticles.title: 🐱 Cat Articles
catArticles.subtitle: Cat-specific information from veterinarians who truly understand feline behavior, backed by Cat Friendly Gold Certification
catArticles.art1title: Kidney Failure in Cats: The Silent Disease to Watch
catArticles.art1snippet: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) is common and a leading cause of death in senior cats. It often shows symptoms only when over 75% of kidney function is lost, making early diagnosis critical.
catArticles.art2title: Why Is My Cat Urinating Outside the Litter Box? Behavior Solutions
catArticles.art2snippet: Inappropriate elimination can be frustrating, but it's actually a signal that something is wrong — whether medical or behavioral.
catArticles.art3snippet: Keep your cat safe from dangerous foods you may not know about. The 7 items to strictly avoid.
catArticles.art4title: Wet or Dry Food: Which is Better? Cat Nutrition Explained
catArticles.art4snippet: A popular question with no single answer! For cats as obligate carnivores with low thirst instincts, food choice requires careful consideration of key factors.
catArticles.art5title: How We Make Cats Comfortable in the Exam Room (Cat Friendly Principles)
catArticles.art5snippet: Pawplan is Cat Friendly Gold Certified, meaning we understand that clinic visits are scary for cats. We improve every step to reduce stress.

healthTips.title: Wellness Tips: Health & Longevity
healthTips.subtitle: A thoughtful pet care guide for physical and mental well-being every day. Learn tips that Pawplan vets want you to know.
healthTips.art1title: 5 Easy Steps to Brush Your Dog's or Cat's Teeth
healthTips.art1snippet: Periodontal Disease is a silent threat found in over 80% of pets aged 3 and above. Daily brushing is the best prevention — but how do you make it easy and get your pet to cooperate?
healthTips.art2title: Dental Chews & Dental Diets: Do They Really Work?
healthTips.art2snippet: Dental Chews and Dental Diets are popular choices, but can they truly replace brushing? Hear from Pawplan veterinarians.
healthTips.art3title: Evaluating Pet Obesity: Is Your Pet "Chubby" or Overweight?
healthTips.art3snippet: Excess weight leads to serious health problems like diabetes, arthritis, and heart disease. Weight assessment using Body Condition Score (BCS) matters more than just scale weight.
healthTips.art4title: Complete Vaccination Schedule for Pets in Thailand
healthTips.art4snippet: Vaccination is not just a legal requirement (rabies vaccine) — it's the most important shield against serious infectious diseases in Thailand's tropical climate.
healthTips.art5title: How to Enrich Your Pet's Environment So They Never Get Bored
healthTips.art5snippet: Pets left alone for long periods may develop boredom leading to destructive behavior or anxiety. Environmental enrichment that stimulates natural instincts is vital for mental health.
healthTips.art6title: Pet First Aid Kit: What Must It Include?
healthTips.art6snippet: Accidents happen. Having a ready first aid kit for your pet can help manage injuries before reaching the clinic.
